claim: For any fixed panel qualities eta_j in (1/2,1], Crowd-BT comparison likelihood is strictly monotone in the Brain-minus-Opus rating difference. Two extensions that preserve the same pre-Brain scoring world and differ only in previously unobserved Brain pairwise outcomes can therefore reverse the Brain-vs-Opus ordering.
purpose: Delete scoring-reconstruction-only work as a purported closure route. Exact owner-scoring algebra cannot infer unseen Brain judgments. Closure requires Brain-specific owner outcomes or a sound stronger target-relation bridge.
